properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used to sign JWT tokens.

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: JWT expiration time in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.oauth2.redirect-uri
properties.description: Frontend redirect URL after OAuth2 login succeeds.

properties.name: app.auth.code-expiration-minutes
properties.description: OTP code validity in minutes.

properties.name: app.auth.dev-return-code
properties.description: Return OTP in API response when email sending fails in development.

properties.name: app.auth.email.queue-name
properties.description: RabbitMQ queue name for asynchronous auth emails.

properties.name: app.auth.email.exchange-name
properties.description: RabbitMQ exchange name for asynchronous auth emails.

properties.name: app.auth.email.routing-key
properties.description: RabbitMQ routing key used for asynchronous auth email messages.

properties.name: app.minio.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable MinIO integration.

properties.name: app.minio.endpoint
properties.description: MinIO endpoint URL.

properties.name: app.minio.access-key
properties.description: MinIO access key.

properties.name: app.minio.secret-key
properties.description: MinIO secret key.

properties.name: app.minio.bucket
properties.description: MinIO bucket for uploaded assets.

properties.name: app.minio.public-base-url
properties.description: Public base URL used to build object URLs.

properties.name: app.flash-sale.queue-name
properties.description: RabbitMQ queue name for flash-sale order requests.

properties.name: app.flash-sale.exchange-name
properties.description: RabbitMQ exchange name for flash-sale events.

properties.name: app.flash-sale.routing-key
properties.description: RabbitMQ routing key used for flash-sale order messages.

properties.name: app.flash-sale.consumer.max-per-second
properties.description: Maximum flash-sale messages processed per second.

properties.name: app.flash-sale.redis-hold-seconds
properties.description: How long seat holds remain in Redis before expiration.

properties.name: app.virtual-queue.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable waiting room virtual queue.

properties.name: app.virtual-queue.batch-size
properties.description: Number of users admitted per dispatch batch.

properties.name: app.virtual-queue.max-active-tokens
properties.description: Maximum admitted users allowed concurrently.

properties.name: app.virtual-queue.admit-ttl-seconds
properties.description: How long an admitted virtual queue token remains valid in seconds.

properties.name: app.virtual-queue.waiting-record-ttl-seconds
properties.description: How long a waiting room queue record is retained in Redis in seconds.

properties.name: app.virtual-queue.estimated-batch-seconds
properties.description: Estimated processing time per batch used for wait-time approximation.

properties.name: app.virtual-queue.dispatch-cooldown-ms
properties.description: Cooldown interval between dispatch attempts in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.events.featured-limit
properties.description: Maximum number of featured events returned by API.
